description: This file defines the Address class, representing customer address information in the web application's data entity layer, including fields like name, address, and contact details.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A Java class representing a customer's address, including properties like name, address lines, city, country, and billing information, with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province of the address.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country code for the address.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Retrieves the company associated with the address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company associated with the address.

methods.name: isBillingAddress
methods.description: Checks if the address is marked as billing address.

methods.name: setBillingAddress
methods.description: Sets whether the address is a billing address.
